subject: Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
text:
Aids to Navigation - Vancouver Harbour
Berry Point Range Front LL 410.7 established in Vancouver Harbour at 49 17.753N 122 59.416W.
Dayboard is trapezoidal, red with a white strip and a range of 2.5NM. 
Light is fixed yellow with a nominal range of 11NM bearing 087 degrees.
